indicator.name: Pending bills
indicator.description: County government pending bills outstanding as at 30 June 2025, in KSh million, using the final FY 2024/25 Table 10 county total.
indicator.expected_source: National Treasury BROP 2025 Table 10; source data Controller of Budget
indicator.expected_availability_note: Final Table 10 reports numeric pending-bills totals for 46 counties. Narok did not submit a pending-bills amount and is governed as official unavailable rather than zero.

observations.source_table: Table 10: County Governments Pending Bills as at 30th June 2025
observations.notes: Final BROP Table 10 county total in KSh million; source of data Controller of Budget. Published national total is 176904.2; displayed 46 reported county rows sum to 176904.5 because of row rounding. No value is created for Narok non-submission.
